items.title: Arsenal East unveils VIBE in Jumeirah Garden City
items.summary: VIBE offers 207 fully furnished homes in Satwa's Jumeirah Garden City: 153 one-bedroom apartments and 54 studios. Pricing, payment plan and handover were not disclosed.

items.title: Tabeer hands over Dh250m 48 Parkside in Arjan
items.summary: Tabeer Developments has completed and handed over its Dh250 million 48 Parkside project of one- to three-bedroom residences in Arjan, roughly 24 months after starting, with residents now moving in.
